title: euphrasia arctica var. obtusata
intro: Euphrasia arctica var. obtusata, commonly known as Arctic Eyebright, is a plant species belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, making it useful in treating respiratory issues like colds and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Euphrasia arctica var. obtusata are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm irritated tissues, while its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully explore the bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions of this plant.
